description.zh: 输入新的工作组描述信息。长度为 2～256 个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the workgroup. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
工作组名称。名称需满足以下要求：

- 任务名称必须唯一。
- 长度为 2~64 个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头，可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、点号（.）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the workgroup. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The workgroup name must be unique.

- The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc modify-workgroup-attribute --workgroup-id w-bp10geepnj916e3d0000 --name testMigrationTaskName --description test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc ModifyWorkgroupAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description test --WorkgroupId 'w-bp10geepnj916e3d0000' --Name testMigrationTaskName
